segments.text: DU, granddaughters! Autumn is coming... I'm already feeling snotty. Let's run through what's going on with crypto. 🟪This week promises to be interesting and volatile: the Senate vote on the CLARITY ACT is tomorrow, and the rate decision is on Wednesday. The chance of the bill passing on the polymarket is only 28%. 🙁 🟪The Tonkeeper wallet has become just Keeper, so don't be alarmed by the update. You can now create a new wallet that supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, TRON, BSC, and other networks—convenient for those who wanted to use one program. What's next? Are we expecting ETH pools on STON.fi?)) 💰BTC $78,100 🔹ETH $2,504 🪙TON $1.34
